subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: First of two diagrams closing CMOA(II)-47 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — the principle-exposure cycle). The prose immediately above argues that by the time a given projection completes its principle-exposure cycle, 'many other dynamic factors at work' have entered — many of which have 'nothing to do with the music (as far as the meta-reality implications of thrust alignment implies)—and some of which are directly the inverse of what the music poses as a positive transformational and vibrational tool.' This crossing diagrams that inversion: PRI-INFO (principle information — the structured exposure-narrative built around a new thrust alignment) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics — what the music actually does vibrationally to listener-communities). (C)PRI-INFO sits as subject in the upper-left with the subject-arrow; AF-DY anchors the upper-right as partner-center. CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) drops directly from the main line, and INFO-INTR (information interpretation) branches from it to the left; (R)EXTN (the reality of existentialism) branches from INFO-INTR to the lower-left margin, and CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) from (R)EXTN. On the partner side, CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) runs diagonally down from the main line; STF (source transfer) rises from it to the right, and (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition) branches from it to the left, with EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) dropping from (R)TM. The structural argument: principle-information crossed with affinity-dynamics carries two side structures from its main line, one through culture-affinity-basis on the subject side and one through culture-information-basis on the partner side.
